newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cisco EPS estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cisco EPS estimates cut.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said analyst Martin Pyykkonen cut his earnings per share estimate on Cisco Systems Inc's fiscal 1997 third quarter ending April 30 to $0.50 from $0.52.
-- He dropped his estimate on Cisco's fiscal fourth quarter to $0.56 from $0.58. Full-year fiscal 1997 estimate is $2.04. Maintained full-year fiscal 1998 view at $2.84.
-- The estimate cuts were due primarily "to near-term uncertainties in revenue growth."
-- Said maintained positive long-term view on Cisco. Stock remains on Furman Selz recommended list with 12-month price target of $70-$75. The stock was off 1-1/8 to 53-1/2.
